Docket No. 07-KRST-143-KSF 
ORDER APPOINTING PREHEARING OFFICER 
The above captioned matter comes before the State Corporation Commission of the State 
of Kansas (Commission) for consideration and decision. Having examined its files and records, 
and being duly advised in the premises, the Commission makes the following findings: 
Appointment of Prehearing Officer 
1. 
Although the Commission will conduct any evidentiary hearing that may be 
necessary in this matter, the Commission designates a prehearing officer to conduct any 
prehearing conferences and to address any matters that are appropriately considered in a 
prehearing conference or addressed by the prehearing officer, including all items listed in the 
Kansas Administrative Procedure Act (KAPA) at K.S.A. 77-517(b) and such other matters that 
will promote the orderly and prompt conduct of this proceeding and any hearing. Among other 
things, the Prehearing Office may order and alter any briefing or comment schedule, issue 
procedural and scheduling orders, issue orders regarding motions to intervene, and take 
administrative notice. The Commission designates Charles Reimer, Advisory Counsel, 1500 SW 

Arrowhead Road, Topeka, KS 66604-4027, telephone 785-271-3361, email address 
c.reimer@kcc.ks.gov, to act as Prehearing Officer in this proceeding. K.S.A. 2010 Supp. 77-
514; K.S.A. 77-516; K.S.A. 2010 Supp. 77-551. The Commission, as it deems necessary, may 
designate other staff members to serve in this capacity. 
IT IS, THEREFORE, BY THE COMMISSION ORDERED THAT: 
A. 
Charles Reimer is designated to serve as Prehearing Officer, as set forth above. 
B. 
The parties have fifteen days, plus three days if service is by mail, from the date 
the order is served in which to petition the Commission, for reconsideration of any issues 
decided herein. K.S.A. 66-118b; K.S.A. 2010 Supp. 77-529(a)(l). 
C. 
The Commission retains jurisdiction over the subject matter and parties for the 
purpose of entering such further orders as it may deem necessary.
